text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume otaku always rises early. Today, I'm running in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting the longest time to see my two top oshis, T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto, race from up close.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I try to control my boiling emotions. I have to stay serious so I don't offend my idols. That's the way it has to be done.
